name: Inflowave
tagline: What if you could replace tools like ManyChat, GoHighLevel, HubSpot add-ons, Zapier zaps, and messy spreadsheets with ONE AI-powered Instagram OS?…
description: What if you could replace tools like ManyChat, GoHighLevel, HubSpot add-ons, Zapier zaps, and messy spreadsheets with ONE AI-powered Instagram OS? What is the ManyChat alternative actually built for agencies managing dozens of IG accounts? What is the GoHighLevel alternative when Instagram is your main sales channel? What is the all‑in‑one CRM alternative to duct‑taping 6–8 tools together just to make DMs work? Inflowave is an AI-powered Instagram CRM and full business operating system for coach
